meta.name: cache-aware-conversational-sentinel
meta.description: Demo hank that fires two observer sentinels in parallel against the same workload: a baseline maxTurns observer and a chunkedWindow + Anthropic ephemeral-cache observer. Used to measure end-to-end cache savings on a long-history conversational sentinel.

hank.name: Read test files sequentially
hank.description: Walks ./data/test-files/ one Read call at a time so each tool.result event drives both observer sentinels.
